html:
SMTO-CMP-0007 — The AI said the task is done but didn't show its proof

GUID: 6890b737-6479-4d35-919a-9bcebddc3cc0
Slug: completion-missing-evidence
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI model said the task was finished but didn't point to any saved results that show it, so SMTO didn't accept the claim. Work already done and its results are kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the task's steps to see which actions ran and whether they succeeded. If they succeeded, SMTO already has the proof; the AI only needs to point to it.
  2. If the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. SMTO asks the AI to name its existing results, which doesn't repeat any action.
  3. If you've checked the result yourself and it's correct, turn off "Enforce this check for this run" on the check card under the task. With this check off for this task only, SMTO can pick the saved results itself instead of waiting for the AI.
  4. Don't select Restart task for this problem. Restart begins a fresh attempt and doesn't undo earlier actions, so changes could happen twice.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed and its final reply appears under it.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. If it happens often with one model, ask them to try a different Main model in Settings › Setup › Model routing. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated; don't restart the task.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • With cited-evidence validation (completion.model_cited_evidence) enabled, an answered or completed declaration for a run with results or action work cited no evidence, outcome_evidence or checks, or receipt verification found results but no cited receipt bundle (reason missing_evidence).

What this means

  • Enabled cited-evidence validation sees no evidence/checks for an evidence-bearing completion, or receipt verification has results but no cited receipt bundle. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Enabled cited-evidence validation sees no evidence/checks for an evidence-bearing completion, or receipt verification has results but no cited receipt bundle.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect whether existing eligible receipts can satisfy the declaration without new execution.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the rejected finish_task arguments: evidence must list this run's own eligible receipts (validate_completion and _verify_receipts in src/agent_runtime/native/completion.py). Resume so the model cites the existing receipts; no new execution is needed when they exist. Turning off completion.model_cited_evidence for the run lets SMTO select eligible receipts itself.
  • Cite existing authoritative operation receipts or obtain the missing evidence before claiming completion.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The declaration cites a supported bounded bundle of authoritative existing receipts.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
